controls.label: Visible color
controls.qualification: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation July 2004, cloud-free global surface mosaic. Deep ocean is shaded from depth, taken from NASA's bathymetry edition of the same month where the plain edition carries its arbitrary constant fill; shallow and coastal water stays observed.

controls.label: Cloud coverage
controls.qualification: Archival NASA Blue Marble cloud composite over July 2004 surface imagery; not live weather. Deep ocean is shaded from depth, taken from NASA's bathymetry edition of the same month where the plain edition carries its arbitrary constant fill.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.qualification: GEBCO_2026 terrain model. Colors show meters above and below mean sea level; relief is shaded for readability. Ocean depths combine measured and estimated terrain. Land includes the ice surface.

controls.label: Night lights
controls.qualification: NASA Black Marble 2016 · Suomi NPP VIIRS night lights from the best cloud-free nights of each month. Land, ice and ocean are NASA's MODIS Blue Marble imagery, added for context. This is an annual composite, not live lighting.

controls.label: ENSO
controls.qualification: NASA MUR · 1 km source imagery · 24 Sept 2026. Sea-surface temperature departure from the 2003–2014 average. NASA colors saturate below −3 and at +3 °C. Gray: land, ice, or unavailable imagery.
